g.text: A timing model leaves the replacement unresolved
Same 64 development images. A declared interpolation model is usable for 973 current car annotations; 62 remain unknown.
Partial contracts retain optional unknown boxes. Strict contracts require complete motion. The union adds preceding-only cars.
All 292 rows and 115 native matching proofs are retained. Seven unresolved rows still have a bound gap.
